lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What happened? I'm all purple...and horny! Chi-Chi's gonna hate this.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: What's mine is yours and yours is mine, as they say.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I'm sorry, you can't have your body anymore. It's mine now.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The radar says we're getting close!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yeah! Would've thought Bulma would've been so compliant?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Why?! Why will you leave me alone here?!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I don't know this place! Did you know there are giant crabs down there?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: OK Bulma, let's just calm down. Why are you upset?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: OK Bulma, if we were to stay here... what would that accomplish?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Thank you, Bulma! Say "thank you", Gohan!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well if you ask me, all she needs is a little bit of Wink Wink Nudge Nudge [tongue clicking] [whistling]

lines.speaker: Mook 1
lines.text: It's called the Wilhelm scream, man. It's like the one in Star Wars where the Stormtrooper falls.

lines.speaker: Mook 2
lines.text: Aah yeah, I love that scream; err, doesn't it sound like, "Eggghhh"?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Fantastic! A little too pink and hairy in odd places, but I'll grow into it.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Well, first off, we have to touch on Freeza's Balls.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Yes yes, realized the moment I said it...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Alright, get your act together. 100x gravity? That's for pussies!'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'The only reason he took those jokers out was because I loosened them up for him - like a jar of space pickles.'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'I just gotta get those Dragon Balls, and if it's anything like that jockstrap incident,'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Ginyu probably buried them somewhere around here.'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Gohan! I think they're buried somwehere around here!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Well...at least I'll have something to put back in the hole.'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'OK - the second they summon the Dragon, I'll swoop in and break the bald one's neck!'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Totally gonna yell "Team Three Star" when I do it too!'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We found them! Krillin, we really did it!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Finally! Now let's hurry up and wish back Piccolo, Tenshinhan and Chiaotzu!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'I don't know what this Yamcha is, but it sounds just like Raditz.'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Eternal Dragon! Rise up, and grant our wish!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: ...it's not working. Is that what you're supposed to say?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Honestly, that's always been pretty vague.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Usually you just gather 'em together and then out pops the Magic Dragon.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Maybe there's something special about Namekian Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Huh...maybe if I sing to it...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ♪ I know a song that gets on everybody's nerves ♪

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, Krillin, I was thinking something else.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Maybe the only way to summon it is to call in its native language.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And the only person I know who does was the toilet! And it's dead...God rest his seat.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Huh? Hey Krillin, I feel two power levels coming this way. You don't think my Dad failed, do you?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No way, Gohan, your Dad's the best! Buut, on the off-chance HIDE YOURSELF!

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Oooy, Cap'n! Someone's dug up the Balls!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Well then, someone's in for the beating of their life.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hehey, Goku! Check it out - we dug up the Dragon Balls!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: How you doin'? Dyou win that fight against that Ginyu guy? Why's that Space New Zealand guy here?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What's up with the Scouter? And do you happen to know anybody who speaks German-

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: -NAH HAH! Aah! Now what was that about?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, of course it's your Dad. Goku, what's your favorite food?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: You see, I've acquired the body of your former associate...Goku, was it?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: And with that, I've gained his power level of 180,000!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Quite. I'm sure you understand now the situation you're in-

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That is *identity* theft! We're gonna sue the crap out of you!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: You can't sue me if I kill you!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No - then you'll get put on trial for murder. HA!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: The devil are you - hoh. Well, look what the Space Cat regurgitated.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey Gohan, hey Krillin, hey Goku!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I'm surprised you're still kicking. How's that wound treating you?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: This is easily the second worst hole I've ever had in my chest.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: It's gonna take, like, a million Mommy kisses to make it better.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, we may have a chance now! But you'll have to give it your all.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Remember - he may look like your Dad, but you can absolutely not hold ba-

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Abandon me for a year with Piccolo, send me off into space, and the next time I get to see you, you lost your damn body?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't know where he gets that from.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: URGH! This is absurd! His power level was a league above my own when we fought!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: What the blazes is going on?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Haha! You don't know any of my techniques!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm not gonna tell you how to use the Kaio-ken!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: If you're not too busy standing there like a slack-jawed idiot, I could use your help!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait...if I'm Ginyu now, does that mean you have to listen to me?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: So... we've been flying for about twenty minutes now.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Because if so, I probably killed them.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hey, Jeice. I've killed every single one of Freeza's flunkies I've gone up against so far - six in total.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: How would you like to be number seven?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Thank you, sir. May I have another?

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: What the hell happened to *you*? You were not this strong when you fought Recoome!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Looks like *you* have some required reading to do.

lines.speaker: Jeice
lines.text: Alright, let's see here...OK, "Full Moon", "Lose Your Tail", "Stronger Every Time You-"... oh...well I'm right f**ked aren't I?

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: All of my men...I'm the only one left.

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: Please...all of you...just...just allow me a customary moment of silence...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hahaha - the best part about *this*? I get to kill both Ginyu *and* Kakarot at the same time!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: I thought his name was Goku.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I know what he said, but he-

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: So what is it? Kakarot or Goku?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *No*, *no*, *no*! Just--look, his Saiyan name is Kakarot, but he changed it when he landed on Earth as a baby, so they kept calling him by his Earth name, and I am calling him by his *real* name!

lines.speaker: Captain Ginyu
lines.text: This is ridiculous! But at least I'm not trapped in some useless body.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Ginyu took my Dad's body, but then he tried to take Vegeta's body, and now he's back in his own body, my Dad's back in his own body, and Vegeta's-

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Now, to switch your body to a *corpse*!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Ah, crap! Kinda walked into this one.'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: A frog got on my hand. It was gross. So I threw it.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So then...is it over? Are they all gone now?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: They will be in a second!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Vegeta, no! He can't hurt anyone anymore! Stop!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: See? He really can be a nice guy!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, I know! How about a good old-fashioned joke?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: How many Namekians does it take to screw in a lightbulb? The whole race!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: One to screw in the lightbulb, and the rest to *die*!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: And then the other too dies too.

segments.title: Purple... and Horny!
segments.quote: What happened? I'm all purple...and horny! Chi-Chi's gonna hate this. ... Goodbye! Enjoy bleeding to death!

segments.title: Just Take the F**king Radar
segments.quote: Did you know there are giant crabs down there?! I do! I *killed* one! ... ...just take the f**king Radar.

segments.title: The Wilhelm Scream
segments.quote: It's called the Wilhelm scream, man. ... Dude that was totally it!

segments.title: Touch on Freeza's Balls
segments.quote: Well, first off, we have to touch on Freeza's Balls. / ...uhhh, sir- / Yes yes, realized the moment I said it...

segments.title: TEAM THREE STAAAR!
segments.quote: 'OK - the second they summon the Dragon, I'll swoop in and break the bald one's neck!' TEAM THREE STAAAR!

segments.title: I Don't Speak German!
segments.quote: Maybe the only way to summon it is to call in its native language. / I don't speak German! And the only person I know who does was the toilet!

segments.title: That Is *Identity* Theft!
segments.quote: Goku, what's your favorite food? / Waldorf salad. / See? Double Baconator-oh s**t. ... That is *identity* theft! We're gonna sue the crap out of you!

segments.title: YOU'RE NOT EVEN YOU ANYMORE!
segments.quote: Abandon me for a year with Piccolo, send me off into space, and the next time I get to see you, you lost your damn body?! / I don't know where he gets that from.

segments.title: Right in the Down Under
segments.quote: ...oh...well I'm right f**ked aren't I? / Right in the Down Under. ... Clever girl...!

segments.title: Kakarot or Goku?
segments.quote: So what is it? Kakarot or Goku? ... ...so does that make *me* Ginyu? / RAAAAAAAAAA

segments.title: It Was Gross. So I Threw It.
segments.quote: Change... 'Ah, crap! Kinda walked into this one.' ...NOOOOW! ... A frog got on my hand. It was gross. So I threw it.

segments.title: The Namekian Lightbulb Joke
segments.quote: How many Namekians does it take to screw in a lightbulb? The whole race! ... Stop ignoring me.
